comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a terminal; record wipes an entire monitor lead outward in one pass and places it on a drape.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed latch release and coupled pull versus direction-constrained wiping along a flexible lead and its end bodies without backtracking.
comparison.success_condition: Clean isolated depinning versus complete outward coverage, no prohibited reverse pass, and released placement on the drape.
comparison.reason: Sharing a wire-like object does not imply overlap; the record tests coverage and stroke history.
